```{python}
import json
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display
from plotly.offline import get_plotlyjs

D = os.path.join(tables_dir, sample)
meta = yaml.safe_load(open(os.path.join(D, "sample-metadata.yaml")))
assert meta["schema_version"] == 1, f"unsupported schema_version {meta['schema_version']}"
tsv = dict(sep="\t", keep_default_na=False, na_values={"af": [""], "dp": [""], "known_expected_af": [""]})
amplicons = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D, "amplicons.tsv"), sep="\t", keep_default_na=False)
variants = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D, "variants.tsv"), **tsv)
homopolymers = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D, "homopolymers.tsv"), sep="\t")
exons = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D, "exons.tsv"), sep="\t")
positions = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(D, "positions.parquet"))
reads = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(D, "reads.parquet"))
alignments = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(D, "alignments.parquet"))
DATASETS = [d for d in ("unfiltered", "filtered") if d in set(positions.dataset)]  # unfiltered drawn on top
MIN_MAPQ = meta["parameters"]["min_mapq"]

COL = dict(sub="#0969da", dele="#cf222e", ins="#8250df", total="#1f2328", bq="#bc4c00", bq_roll="#762c00",
           A="#2da44e", C="#0969da", G="#bf8700", T="#cf222e", low="#c8c8c8", exon="#57606a")
POOL_COL = {"1": "#2da44e", "2": "#cf222e", "3": "#1b9aaa"}
CAT = dict(pass_=("PASS", "#0969da"), filtered=("Soft-filtered", "#8c959f"), known_pass=("Known, PASS", "#d1242f"),
           known_filtered=("Known, soft-filtered", "#e16f24"), known_not_called=("Known, not called", "#8250df"))


def cat(c):
    """Display name and colour of a variant category.

    Args:
        c: category from variants.tsv: pass, filtered, known_pass, known_filtered or known_not_called.

    Returns:
        (label, hex colour), e.g. ("Known, PASS", "#d1242f"). (CAT spells "pass" as "pass_": dict(pass=...) is
        a syntax error.)
    """
    return CAT["pass_" if c == "pass" else c]


# caller -> (display name, Plotly marker symbol, marker size, HTML glyph for the table)
CALLERS =dict(clairs_to=("ClairS-TO", "circle-open", 6, "&#9675;"), deepsomatic=("DeepSomatic", "square-open", 9, "&#9633;"),
               vardict=("VarDict", "diamond-open", 13, "&#9671;"))
GERMLINE_FILTERS = {"PopAF_0.02", "GERMLINE", "NonSomatic"}  # FILTER values that mark a likely germline variant


def r5(a):
    """Round numbers for JSON: iterable of numbers -> list of floats with 5 decimals, NaN and infinity -> None.

    JSON has no NaN, and Plotly draws None as a gap.
    """
    return [None if not np.isfinite(v) else round(float(v), 5) for v in a]


def jdump(o):
    """Serialise o as compact JSON for embedding in the page.

    numpy scalars become Python numbers (via .item()); any other type json cannot handle becomes its str().
    """
    return json.dumps(o, separators=(",", ":"), default=lambda x: x.item() if hasattr(x, "item") else str(x))


def esc(s):
    """Escape &, < and > so that text such as the symbolic ALT "<INS>" shows literally in HTML and hover text."""
    return str(s).replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;")


# plotly.js, embedded once. Quarto adds require.js to this page, and plotly.js registers itself as an AMD module
# instead of window.Plotly when `define` exists, so hide `define` while it loads.
display(HTML("<script>window.__nvDefine = window.define; window.define = undefined;</script>"
             f"<script>{get_plotlyjs()}</script><script>window.define = window.__nvDefine;</script>"))
```

```{python}
def series(chrom, start, end, dataset):
    """Compute the read noise of one dataset over a region, both strands summed.

    Reads the global `positions` table (raw counts per position, dataset and strand). Thresholds (minimum depth,
    rolling window) are not applied here: nv.html applies them in the browser.

    Args:
        chrom: chromosome name.
        start, end: the region, 1-based closed.
        dataset: "filtered" or "unfiltered".

    Returns:
        (pos, ref, series):
            pos: numpy array of the 1-based positions that have rows in positions.parquet, sorted;
            ref: list of reference bases, one per position;
            series: dict of lists, one value per position:
                depth: A + C + G + T + N + deletions;
                sub: A, C, G or T bases differing from the reference, as a fraction of depth;
                dele, ins: deletions and insertions as fractions of depth;
                total: sub + dele + ins;
                bq: mean base quality (None where no base has a quality).
        Fractions divide by max(depth, 1), so a position without reads gives 0, not NaN.
    """
    p = positions[(positions.chrom == chrom) & (positions.pos.between(start, end)) & (positions.dataset == dataset)]
    g = p.groupby("pos", sort=True)[["A", "C", "G", "T", "N", "del", "ins", "bq_sum", "bq_n"]].sum()
    ref = p[p.strand == "+"].set_index("pos").ref.reindex(g.index)
    bases = g[["A", "C", "G", "T"]]
    match = np.array([bases.at[i, r] if r in "ACGT" else 0 for i, r in zip(g.index, ref)])
    depth = (bases.sum(axis=1) + g.N + g["del"]).to_numpy()
    d = np.maximum(depth, 1)
    sub = (bases.sum(axis=1).to_numpy() - match) / d
    dele, ins = g["del"].to_numpy() / d, g.ins.to_numpy() / d
    return g.index.to_numpy(), ref.tolist(), dict(depth=depth.tolist(), sub=r5(sub), dele=r5(dele), ins=r5(ins),
                                                  total=r5(sub + dele + ins), bq=r5(g.bq_sum / g.bq_n.replace(0, np.nan)))


def overlapping(a):
    """List the amplicons for the amplicons track of one amplicon's view.

    Args:
        a: one row of `amplicons` (a namedtuple from itertuples(); 1-based closed start and end).

    Returns:
        DataFrame of `amplicons` rows: a itself first, then every other amplicon on the same chromosome
        overlapping it by at least 1 bp, sorted by start.
    """
    o =amplicons[(amplicons.chrom == a.chrom) & (amplicons.name != a.name) & (amplicons.start <= a.end) & (amplicons.end >= a.start)]
    return pd.concat([amplicons[amplicons.name == a.name], o.sort_values("start")])


def region_reads(a, dataset):
    """Count the reads of a dataset that overlap amplicon a's region, for the panel subtitles.

    Counts the alignments in `alignments` (primary only) with MAPQ >= MIN_MAPQ that overlap a by at least 1 bp:
    the reads that can contribute to the read noise there, whichever amplicon they come from.

    Args:
        a: one row of `amplicons`.
        dataset: "filtered" or "unfiltered".

    Returns:
        The number of reads (int).
    """
    x =alignments[(alignments.dataset == dataset) & (alignments.chrom == a.chrom) & (alignments.mapq >= MIN_MAPQ)]
    return int(((x.start <= a.end) & (x.end >= a.start)).sum())


def variant_label(v):
    """Short label of a known variant, e.g. "TP53 p.R175H".

    Args:
        v: one row of `variants` (a namedtuple).

    Returns:
        "<gene> <protein change>"; without a protein change, "<gene> REF>ALT" (a symbolic ALT such as <INS>
        shows as INS). "" for a variant that is not in the known-variants list. Not HTML-escaped.
    """
    if v.known_gene:
        return f"{v.known_gene} {v.known_hgvsp or (v.alt.strip('<>') if v.alt.startswith('<') else v.ref + '>' + v.alt)}"
    return ""


def variant_hover(v):
    """Hover text of a variant marker, as HTML for Plotly.

    Args:
        v: one row of `variants`.

    Returns:
        Lines with: position and change; status, with the label of a known variant; AF and DP (for a known
        variant that was not called, its expected AF instead); FILTER; CALLERS; artifact annotation
        (observations, median, NrSD), each line only when the value is present.
    """
    s =f"{v.pos} {esc(v.ref)}&gt;{esc(v.alt)}<br>{cat(v.category)[0]}"
    s += f" - {esc(variant_label(v))}" if v.known_gene else ""
    s += f"<br>AF {100 * v.af:.2f}%  DP {int(v.dp)}" if pd.notna(v.af) else (
        f"<br>expected AF {100 * v.known_expected_af:.0f}%" if pd.notna(v.known_expected_af) else "<br>expected AF not given")
    s += f"<br>FILTER {v.filter}" if v.filter else ""
    s += f"<br>CALLERS {v.callers}" if v.callers else ""
    s += f"<br>Artifact obs {v.artifact}  median {v.artifact_median}  NrSD {v.artifact_nrsd}" if v.artifact else ""
    return s


def variant_cd(v):
    """Per-variant data the browser needs to find the variant and to hide germline variants.

    Stored as Plotly customdata on the variant markers and as data-cd on the table rows. nv.html treats a variant
    as germline when it is not known, is a substitution, and either has a germline filter or af >= the
    "Germline VAF" control.

    Args:
        v: one row of `variants`.

    Returns:
        [pos, af, is_substitution, has_germline_filter, is_known]:
            pos: 1-based position; af: float, None when not called;
            is_substitution: 1 when REF and ALT have the same length and ALT is not symbolic (SNV or MNV), else 0;
            has_germline_filter: 1 when FILTER contains one of GERMLINE_FILTERS, else 0;
            is_known: 1 for the known_* categories, else 0.
    """
    return [int(v.pos), None if pd.isna(v.af) else float(v.af), int(len(v.ref) == len(v.alt) and not v.alt.startswith("<")),
            int(bool(set(v.filter.split(";")) & GERMLINE_FILTERS)), int(v.category.startswith("known"))]


def amplicon_spec(a):
    """Build the figure spec of one amplicon tab, which nv.html turns into the interactive Plotly figure.

    Panels, top to bottom, each on its own y axis with a fixed height in pixels, all sharing the x axis
    (genomic position):
        y6, y7: read noise and base quality of the unfiltered reads (only when both datasets are present);
        y, y2: read noise and base quality of the filtered reads;
        y8: amplicons track: a and the amplicons overlapping it, coloured by pool, with ticks where the others
            start and end;
        y3: homopolymers; y4: exons;
        y5: variants on a log AF axis (marker shape = caller, colour = status).

    The per-position traces carry no x and y here. Their meta.role tells nv.html how to fill them from `series`
    with the current controls: noise (sub/del/ins at positions with depth >= minimum depth), low (total noise
    below minimum depth), total, roll (rolling mean, window from the controls), bq (base quality). Traces with
    role hp (homopolymers, filtered by minimum length) and var (variants, germline hiding) are filtered in place.

    Args:
        a: one row of `amplicons`.

    Returns:
        (spec, vs):
            spec: dict with pos (positions), start, end, series ({dataset: series()[2]}), data (Plotly traces),
                layout (Plotly layout), noiseAxes (the read-noise y axes, switched by the log-scale control),
                afAxis (the variants axis, which also gets the reference lines) and rq (Plotly data and layout of
                the amplicon's read-quality histogram: amplicon reads only, see alignments.amplicon);
            vs: the rows of `variants` inside a, for variant_table().
    """
    pos = None
    S, refs = {}, None
    for ds in DATASETS:
        pos, refs, S[ds] = series(a.chrom, a.start, a.end, ds)
    traces = []
    for ds in DATASETS:
        ax, bqax = ("y6", "y7") if ds == "unfiltered" and len(DATASETS) == 2 else ("y", "y2")
        first = ds == DATASETS[0]

        def common(name):
            """Legend settings shared by both datasets' copy of a trace: one legend entry (from the first
            dataset) toggles both."""
            return dict(legendgroup=name, showlegend=first)

        traces += [
            dict(type="scattergl", mode="markers", name="total noise", visible="legendonly", yaxis=ax, marker=dict(size=3, color=COL["total"]),
                 meta=dict(x="pos", role="total", ds=ds), hovertemplate="%{x}: total %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>", **common("total noise")),
            *[dict(type="scattergl", mode="markers", name=n, yaxis=ax, marker=dict(size=3.5, color=COL[k], opacity=0.75),
                   meta=dict(x="pos", role="noise", ds=ds, kind=k), hovertemplate=f"%{{x}}: {k.rstrip('e')} %{{y:.2%}}<extra>{ds}</extra>", **common(n))
              for k, n in (("sub", "substitutions"), ("dele", "deletions"), ("ins", "insertions"))],
            dict(type="scattergl", mode="markers", name="total noise, low depth", yaxis=ax, marker=dict(size=3, color=COL["low"]),
                 meta=dict(x="pos", role="low", ds=ds), hovertemplate="%{x}: total %{y:.2%} (low depth)<extra></extra>", **common("low")),
            dict(type="scatter", mode="lines", yaxis=ax, line=dict(color=COL["total"], width=1.5), hoverinfo="skip",
                 meta=dict(x="pos", role="roll", ds=ds, of="total", label="total noise"), **common("roll total")),
            *[dict(type="scatter", mode="lines", visible="legendonly", yaxis=ax, line=dict(color=COL[k], width=1.2), hoverinfo="skip",
                   meta=dict(x="pos", role="roll", ds=ds, of=k, label=k.rstrip("e")), **common(f"roll {k}")) for k in ("sub", "dele", "ins")],
            dict(type="scattergl", mode="markers", name="base quality", yaxis=bqax, marker=dict(size=3, color=COL["bq"], opacity=0.6),
                 meta=dict(x="pos", role="bq", ds=ds), hovertemplate="%{x}: Q%{y}<extra></extra>", **common("bq")),
            dict(type="scatter", mode="lines", yaxis=bqax, line=dict(color=COL["bq_roll"], width=1.5), hoverinfo="skip",
                 meta=dict(x="pos", role="roll", ds=ds, of="bq", label="base quality"), **common("roll bq")),
        ]
    # amplicons track
    ov = overlapping(a)

    def cut(r):
        """Span of amplicon row r clipped to a's span: (start, end), 1-based closed."""
        return max(r.start, a.start), min(r.end, a.end)

    traces.append(dict(type="bar", orientation="h", yaxis="y8", showlegend=False, width=0.7, y=list(range(len(ov))),
                       base=[cut(r)[0] - 0.5 for r in ov.itertuples()], x=[cut(r)[1] - cut(r)[0] + 1 for r in ov.itertuples()],
                       marker=dict(color=[POOL_COL.get(str(r.pool), COL["exon"]) for r in ov.itertuples()],
                                   line=dict(color=[COL["total"]] + ["rgba(0,0,0,0)"] * (len(ov) - 1), width=[2.5] + [0] * (len(ov) - 1))),
                       hovertext=[f"{r.name}, pool {r.pool}<br>{r.start:,}-{r.end:,}" for r in ov.itertuples()], hoverinfo="text"))
    ticks = [(k, p, i + 1, r.name) for i, r in enumerate(ov.iloc[1:].itertuples()) for k, p in (("start", r.start), ("end", r.end))
             if a.start < p < a.end]
    traces.append(dict(type="scatter", mode="markers+text", yaxis="y8", showlegend=False, cliponaxis=False,
                       x=[t[1] for t in ticks], y=[t[2] for t in ticks], text=[f"{t[1]:,}" for t in ticks],
                       textposition=["middle left" if t[0] == "start" else "middle right" for t in ticks], textfont=dict(size=10),
                       marker=dict(symbol="line-ns", size=18, line=dict(width=2, color=COL["total"])),
                       hovertext=[f"{t[3]} {t[0]} {t[1]:,}" for t in ticks], hoverinfo="text"))
    for pool in sorted(set(ov.pool.astype(str))):
        traces.append(dict(type="bar", yaxis="y8", x=[None], y=[None], name=f"pool {pool}", marker=dict(color=POOL_COL.get(pool, COL["exon"]))))
    # homopolymers (all runs >= 3 bp; the minimum length is applied in the browser) and exons
    hp = homopolymers[(homopolymers.chrom == a.chrom) & (homopolymers.start >= a.start) & (homopolymers.end <= a.end)]
    traces.append(dict(type="bar", yaxis="y3", base=0, name="homopolymers", x=((hp.start + hp.end) / 2).tolist(), y=[1] * len(hp),
                       width=(hp.end - hp.start + 1).tolist(), marker=dict(color=[COL[b] for b in hp.base]), customdata=hp.length.tolist(),
                       text=[f"{b}x{n}" for b, n in zip(hp.base, hp.length)], textposition="inside", textfont=dict(size=9, color="#fff"),
                       hovertext=[f"{b} x {n}<br>{s}-{e}" for b, n, s, e in zip(hp.base, hp.length, hp.start, hp.end)], hoverinfo="text",
                       meta=dict(role="hp")))
    ex = exons[(exons.chrom == a.chrom) & (exons.end >= a.start) & (exons.start <= a.end)]
    traces.append(dict(type="bar", yaxis="y4", base=0, name="exons", x=((ex.start + ex.end) / 2).tolist(), y=[1] * len(ex),
                       width=(ex.end - ex.start + 1).tolist(), marker=dict(color=COL["exon"]),
                       text=[f"{g} exon {n}" for g, n in zip(ex.gene, ex.exon)], textposition="inside", textfont=dict(size=10, color="#fff"),
                       hovertext=[f"{g} exon {n} ({t}, {s} strand)" for g, n, t, s in zip(ex.gene, ex.exon, ex.transcript, ex.strand)],
                       hoverinfo="text"))
    # variants: shape = caller, colour = status
    vs = variants[(variants.chrom == a.chrom) & (variants.pos.between(a.start, a.end))]

    def vy(v):
        """Height of variant v on the AF axis: its AF; for a known variant that was not called, its expected AF,
        or 0.45% (just above the axis bottom) when that is not given either."""
        return v.af if pd.notna(v.af) else (v.known_expected_af if pd.notna(v.known_expected_af) else 0.0045)

    for c, (cname, sym, size, _) in CALLERS.items():
        cv = [v for v in vs.itertuples() if c in v.callers.split(",")]
        traces.append(dict(type="scatter", mode="markers", x=[None], y=[None], yaxis="y5", name=f"caller: {cname}", legendgroup=c,
                           marker=dict(symbol=sym, size=size, color="#57606a", line=dict(width=1.5, color="#57606a"))))
        cols = [cat(v.category)[1] for v in cv]
        traces.append(dict(type="scatter", mode="markers", yaxis="y5", name=cname, legendgroup=c, showlegend=False,
                           x=[v.pos for v in cv], y=[vy(v) for v in cv], customdata=[variant_cd(v) for v in cv],
                           hovertext=[variant_hover(v) for v in cv], hoverinfo="text",
                           marker=dict(symbol=sym, size=size, color=cols, line=dict(width=1.5, color=cols)), meta=dict(role="var")))
    nc = [v for v in vs.itertuples() if v.category == "known_not_called"]
    traces.append(dict(type="scatter", mode="markers", yaxis="y5", name="known, not called (expected AF)",
                       x=[v.pos for v in nc], y=[vy(v) for v in nc], customdata=[variant_cd(v) for v in nc],
                       hovertext=[variant_hover(v) for v in nc], hoverinfo="text", meta=dict(role="var"),
                       marker=dict(symbol="x-thin-open", size=10, color=CAT["known_not_called"][1], line=dict(width=2.5, color=CAT["known_not_called"][1]))))
    kn = [v for v in vs.itertuples() if v.known_gene]
    traces.append(dict(type="scatter", mode="text", yaxis="y5", showlegend=False, hoverinfo="skip", x=[v.pos for v in kn], y=[vy(v) for v in kn],
                       text=[esc(variant_label(v)) for v in kn], textposition="top center", customdata=[variant_cd(v) for v in kn],
                       textfont=dict(size=12, color=[cat(v.category)[1] for v in kn]), meta=dict(role="var")))
    for k in ("pass", "filtered", "known_pass", "known_filtered"):
        traces.append(dict(type="scatter", mode="markers", x=[None], y=[None], yaxis="y5", name=f"status: {cat(k)[0]}", legendgroup="status",
                           marker=dict(symbol="square", size=8, color=cat(k)[1])))

    # layout: fixed px heights, top to bottom [axis, height, gap below]
    two = len(DATASETS) == 2
    stack = ([("y6", 170, 25), ("y7", 90, 120)] if two else []) + [("y", 160 if two else 240, 25), ("y2", 90 if two else 130, 45),
             ("y8", 24 * len(ov), 30), ("y3", 30, 25), ("y4", 30, 50), ("y5", 410 if two else 270, 0)]
    area = sum(h + g for _, h, g in stack)
    dom, top = {}, 0
    for ax, h, g in stack:
        dom[ax] = [(area - top - h) / area, (area - top) / area]
        top += h + g
    legend_of = {"y": "legend", "y6": "legend", "y2": "legend2", "y7": "legend2", "y8": "legend5", "y3": "legend3", "y4": "legend3", "y5": "legend4"}
    for t in traces:
        t["legend"] = legend_of[t["yaxis"]]
    noise_axis = dict(tickformat=".1%", rangemode="tozero")
    total_reads = {ds: int((reads.dataset == ds).sum()) for ds in DATASETS}

    def subtitle(ds, ax):
        """Plotly annotation above the read-noise panel on axis ax: the read counts of dataset ds."""
        return dict(
            text=f"<b>{ds.capitalize()} reads</b> - {region_reads(a, ds):,} reads in this amplicon region (primary, MAPQ ≥ {MIN_MAPQ}) "
                 f"of {total_reads[ds]:,} reads in the dataset",
            xref="paper", x=0, xanchor="left", yref="paper", y=dom[ax][1], yanchor="bottom", yshift=4, showarrow=False,
            font=dict(size=12, color="#57606a"))

    layout = dict(
        height=area + 70, margin=dict(l=100, r=10, t=30, b=40), hovermode="closest", dragmode="zoom", bargap=0,
        xaxis=dict(title="position", showspikes=True, spikemode="across", spikesnap="cursor", spikethickness=1, spikedash="solid",
                   spikecolor="#57606a", anchor="y5", range=[int(a.start), int(a.end)]),
        yaxis=dict(noise_axis, domain=dom["y"], title="read noise,<br>filtered" if two else "read noise"),
        yaxis2=dict(domain=dom["y2"], title="base quality,<br>filtered" if two else "base quality", range=[0, 50]),
        yaxis3=dict(domain=dom["y3"], showticklabels=False, showgrid=False, zeroline=False, range=[0, 1]),
        yaxis4=dict(domain=dom["y4"], showticklabels=False, showgrid=False, zeroline=False, range=[0, 1]),
        yaxis5=dict(domain=dom["y5"], title="variant AF", type="log", tickformat=".1%", range=[np.log10(0.004), 0.08],
                    tickvals=[0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1]),
        yaxis8=dict(domain=dom["y8"], range=[len(ov) - 0.5, -0.5], tickvals=list(range(len(ov))), ticktext=ov.name.tolist(),
                    showgrid=False, zeroline=False, tickfont=dict(size=11), fixedrange=True),
        annotations=[dict(text=t, xref="paper", x=-0.01, xanchor="right", yref="paper", y=sum(dom[ax]) / 2, showarrow=False, font=dict(size=12))
                     for t, ax in (("homopolymers", "y3"), ("exons", "y4"))] + [subtitle("filtered", "y")]
                    + ([subtitle("unfiltered", "y6")] if two else []),
        shapes=[dict(type="line", xref="paper", x0=-0.1, x1=1.25, yref="paper", y0=(dom["y7"][0] + dom["y"][1]) / 2 + 10 / area,
                     y1=(dom["y7"][0] + dom["y"][1]) / 2 + 10 / area, line=dict(color="#d0d7de", width=1.5))] if two else [],
        **{k: dict(groupclick="togglegroup", font=dict(size=11), x=1.01, xanchor="left", y=dom[ax][1], yanchor="top", tracegroupgap=2)
           for k, ax in (("legend", "y6" if two else "y"), ("legend2", "y7" if two else "y2"), ("legend5", "y8"), ("legend3", "y3"), ("legend4", "y5"))},
    )
    if two:
        layout["yaxis6"] = dict(noise_axis, domain=dom["y6"], title="read noise,<br>unfiltered", matches="y")
        layout["yaxis7"] = dict(domain=dom["y7"], title="base quality,<br>unfiltered", range=[0, 50])
    # per-amplicon read quality: amplicon reads (alignments.amplicon) joined to their FASTQ read quality
    bins = np.arange(0, 50.5, 0.5)
    rq = []
    for ds, color, fill in (("filtered", "#0969da", "tozeroy"), ("unfiltered", "#bc4c00", None)):
        if ds not in DATASETS:
            continue
        ids = alignments[(alignments.dataset == ds) & (alignments.amplicon == a.name)].read_id
        q = reads[(reads.dataset == ds) & reads.read_id.isin(ids)].mean_q
        h, _ = np.histogram(q, bins=bins)
        rq.append(dict(type="scatter", mode="lines", x=(bins[:-1] + 0.25).tolist(), y=r5(100 * h / max(len(q), 1)), fill=fill,
                       line=dict(shape="hvh", width=2.5, color=color), name=f"{a.name}, {ds} (n={len(q):,}, median Q{q.median():.2f})"))
    rq_layout = dict(height=300, margin=dict(l=100, r=10, t=10, b=40), xaxis=dict(title="read quality (Q)", range=[0, 40]),
                     yaxis=dict(title="% of reads"), hovermode="x unified", legend=dict(x=0.01, y=0.98))
    return dict(pos=pos.tolist(), start=int(a.start), end=int(a.end), series=S, data=traces, layout=layout,
                noiseAxes=["y6", "y"] if two else ["y"], afAxis="y5", rq=dict(data=rq, layout=rq_layout)), vs


def variant_table(vs):
    """HTML table of one amplicon's variants, shown next to its plot.

    Rows are ordered known PASS, known soft-filtered, known not called, PASS, soft-filtered, then by position.
    Each row carries data-pos (a click zooms the plot there) and data-cd (variant_cd(), for germline hiding).
    data-quarto-disable-processing stops Quarto from restyling the raw table, which otherwise drops it.

    Args:
        vs: rows of `variants` (from amplicon_spec()).

    Returns:
        The table as an HTML string, with columns pos, change (and the known label), AF (or the expected AF of a
        known variant that was not called), callers (one glyph per caller), status, FILTER.
    """
    order = dict(known_pass=0, known_filtered=1, known_not_called=2, **{"pass": 3, "filtered": 4})
    vs = vs.assign(o=vs.category.map(order)).sort_values(["o", "pos"])

    def short(s):
        """Escape an allele for HTML, shortened to its first 3 bases + "…" when longer than 5."""
        return esc(s[:3]) + "&hellip;" if len(s) > 5 else esc(s)

    rows = []
    for v in vs.itertuples():
        name, color = cat(v.category)
        af = f"{100 * v.af:.2f}%" if pd.notna(v.af) else ("(exp. %.0f%%)" % (100 * v.known_expected_af) if pd.notna(v.known_expected_af) else "")
        glyphs = "".join(CALLERS[c][3] for c in v.callers.split(",") if c in CALLERS)
        rows.append(f"<tr class='v' data-pos='{v.pos}' data-cd='{jdump(variant_cd(v))}'><td>{v.pos}</td>"
                    f"<td>{short(v.ref)}&gt;{short(v.alt)}{'<br><b>' + esc(variant_label(v)) + '</b>' if v.known_gene else ''}</td>"
                    f"<td>{af}</td><td>{glyphs}</td><td><span class='nv-badge' style='background:{color}'>{name}</span></td>"
                    f"<td>{esc(v.filter)}</td></tr>")
    return ("<table data-quarto-disable-processing='true'><thead><tr><th>pos</th><th>change</th><th>AF</th><th>callers</th><th>status</th><th>FILTER</th></tr></thead><tbody>"
            + "".join(rows) + "</tbody></table>")
```

    print(f"\n## {a.name}\n")

          f"<div class='nv-row'><div class='nv-plot' id='nv-plot-{a.name}'></div><div class='nv-table'>{variant_table(vs)}</div></div>"
          f"<div id='nv-rq-{a.name}'></div></div>")
    print(f"<script>NV.add({json.dumps(a.name)}, {jdump(spec)});</script>")

## Read quality

```{python}
#| output: asis
lines = []
for ds in DATASETS:
    al = alignments[alignments.dataset == ds]
    on = al[al.chrom.notna() & (al.mapq >= MIN_MAPQ) & ((al.span_match > 0))]
    unmatched = int(on.amplicon.isna().sum())
    n_reads, in_bam = int((reads.dataset == ds).sum()), int(al.read_id.nunique())
    lines.append(f"**{ds.capitalize()}:** {n_reads:,} reads; {n_reads - in_bam:,} ({100 * (n_reads - in_bam) / n_reads:.1f}%) "
                 f"not in the BAM; {unmatched:,} of {len(on):,} on-target reads ({100 * unmatched / max(len(on), 1):.1f}%) match no amplicon.")
print("\n\n".join(lines))
```
